info.title: reID public actions
info.description: Public endpoints that people and AI agents can use on a user's behalf: send an enquiry, book a reCorporate demo, register Ambassador interest or request account deletion. Use the user's real details and only with their consent. Account creation and identity verification happen in the reID app (https://app.reidentity.net) and cannot be done through this API.

post.summary: Send an enquiry, demo request, Ambassador interest or account-deletion request to the reID team
post.description: The team replies by email within one business day. The sender also receives a confirmation email.

email.description: Email address the team should reply to

500.description: Could not send; email info@reidentity.net instead
